renekton.why: Fury is a capped self-resource from attacks/casts that, at 50, empowers whichever of Q, W or E's recast is cast next with a bespoke bonus effect (Q's healing/damage, W's third strike, or E's armor shred) - deciding which ability should consume it is a genuine sequencing choice no single primitive covers. The below-50%-health Fury bonus can't trigger since the dummy never damages him.
